overview_description.description: Nexthop AI develops networking infrastructure designed to support artificial intelligence workloads in large-scale cloud computing environments. The company builds custom networking hardware and integrates it with software platforms and open network operating systems used in data center deployments. Its offerings include switching systems, network operating system integration, and validated optical and electrical interconnect components that connect compute clusters used for AI training and inference. Nexthop AI works with cloud operators to design network architectures that align with their infrastructure requirements and existing technology stacks. The company also provides engineering collaboration, system integration, and network design support to assist organizations deploying and scaling AI-focused data center environments.
